conceptZh: 長披風英雄想飛上終點，卻被披風蒙頭撞倒連鎖筆畫架，最後被彈起、踩下末筆，排成「噴」後得意地噴出布偶火焰。
object: An original caped action figure and one integrated domino apparatus made of hinged dark-blue glyph strokes.
morph: A small cape-blinded bump starts an accelerating domino cascade; hinged stroke pieces fall into their exact positions, and the hero's final landing presses the last stroke into place.
creativeAngle: 把密集筆畫做成同一座連鎖機關，以披風蒙頭引發骨牌效應；英雄最後踩下末筆再彈到字外，讓大撞擊、正確字形與噴火示範各自清楚可讀。
promptEn:
Create an 8-second stylized 3D animated slapstick clip in one locked frontal view, on a pale butter-yellow stage. Cast one original, boastful caped action-figure hero with obvious molded joints, a round expressive face, and a cape three sizes too long. His sole prop is an integrated domino apparatus: chunky dark-blue stroke pieces hinged to a shallow backing, engineered to assemble the exact Traditional Chinese glyph 噴. Bright, soft lighting; clear silhouettes.

0.0–1.5s: The hero spots the apparatus's final landing pad and confidently points at it, determined to fly there. He launches horizontally; his enormous cape immediately flops over his face. His outstretched finger gives the first hinged stroke a tiny bump. At that contact, the off-screen voice says the first 「噴」, and a short visible puff bursts from his surprised mouth as the first piece falls.

1.5–3.2s: Blindly paddling through the air, he misses his landing. The bumped piece knocks the next, then the next: three plainly visible waves accelerate across the apparatus with soft wooden clacks. Each falling stroke rotates into its assigned glyph position and locks flat. Keep the chain in one readable plane, with no loose debris. The hero lifts one corner of his cape, sees the cascade catching him, and gives an enormous sheepish grin.

3.2–5.0s: The final falling lever gently BONKS his padded bottom and flips him in a single forward somersault. He lands feet-first on the last pad with squash-and-stretch; that landing depresses the remaining lower-right stroke of 貝 into position. The complete 噴 locks at 4.7s as the voice says the second 「噴」 and a tiny mouth-puff accompanies his surprised thumbs-up. The springy pad rebounds him into the clear lower-right margin by 5.0s, leaving every stroke exposed.

5.0–8.0s: Hold the finished glyph absolutely still, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height, with generous margins. Preserve the exact standard structure: compact 口 on the left and correctly proportioned 賁 on the right, with every interior gap open. At 5.7–6.8s, say 「噴火」 exactly as the hero proudly spouts a short curling tongue of orange felt-like cartoon flame into the empty outer margin. He looks delighted, then silently wrestles the drooping cape off his face again. Nothing overlaps the glyph.

Audio: warm, friendly off-screen Taiwanese Mandarin, slowly and distinctly, exact line 「噴、噴、噴火」 (ㄆㄣ、ㄆㄣ、ㄆㄣ ㄏㄨㄛˇ). Read those syllables with clear tones and pauses at the specified moments; stop after the word. Soft clacks and a cushioned bonk stay below the voice. Only 噴 appears as text; no captions, other lettering, logos, watermarks, clutter, or flashing effects.
